title: 恒地CFO：中环写字楼出租率95%，其他区域仍承压
speaker: Andrew Fong

segments.en: I want to talk about offices and commercial. Where do you think we are in the recovery?
segments.zh: 我想谈谈写字楼和商业地产。你认为我们处于复苏的哪个阶段？

segments.en: As you know, the Henderson is now 95% list out.
segments.zh: 如你所知，Henderson的出租率已达95%。

segments.en: And we have a little problem for the central yard.
segments.zh: 中环项目有一点小问题。

segments.en: A little problem. We have very little problem. A very little problem.
Yeah, because one single company has at least 75% of the time.
segments.zh: 因为一家公司就占了至少75%的面积。

segments.en: So actually, there's only around 70,000 square feet to land out for the phase one.
segments.zh: 所以一期其实只有约7万平方英尺待租。

segments.en: So the phase one will be delivered by the end of this year and to be open, hopefully around mid-year.
segments.zh: 一期将在今年年底交付，希望年中左右开业。

segments.en: So the central is doing quite well, as you see, the occupancy is high.
segments.zh: 中环表现相当好，入住率很高。

segments.en: And there's a little bit of upside adjustment for rental as a whole, not just us.
segments.zh: 整体租金有轻微上调，不只是我们。

segments.en: But overall, the other areas are still challenging.
segments.zh: 但总体而言，其他区域仍面临挑战。

segments.en: The central is the central. The high end is the high end.
segments.zh: 中环就是中环，高端就是高端。

segments.en: But we see little progress in other areas.
But of course, the student hostel helps some of the outside areas.
segments.zh: 当然，学生公寓对部分外围区域有帮助。
